name: @classekit/education-core
description: Portable assessment primitives for francophone education software.

scripts.test:cli: node bin/classekit.mjs validate examples/assessment.json --json && node bin/classekit.mjs validate examples/assessment.json && node bin/classekit.mjs validate-score examples/result-perfect.json && node bin/classekit.mjs summary examples/assessment.json && node bin/classekit.mjs score examples/assessment.json examples/answers.json --partial-credit && node bin/classekit.mjs recommend examples/assessment.json examples/answers.json && node bin/classekit.mjs shuffle examples/assessment.json --seed=42 && node bin/classekit.mjs stats examples/result-perfect.json examples/result-empty.json && node bin/classekit.mjs export-json examples/assessment.json && node bin/classekit.mjs export-csv examples/assessment.json && node bin/classekit.mjs export-md examples/assessment.json --locale=fr && node bin/classekit.mjs export-html examples/assessment.json --locale=fr && node test/cli-smoke.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run test:api && npm run test:cli
